sentences.en: A ship which conveys oil is called an oil tanker.
sentences.zh: 一艘运输原油的船被称为油轮。

sentences.en: A ship that transports oil is called an oil tanker.
sentences.zh: 一艘运送石油的船被称为油轮。

sentences.en: The oil often spilled by tankers also adds to water pollution.
sentences.zh: 油轮泄漏的油往往也会增加水污染。

senses.zh: 油罐车,油轮,一辆坦克乘员中的一名
